provenance.source: the ten frames of 01_assy_0_1.mp4 at 88 to 106 s, drafted under O_DEMO, P_ISG and EXAMPLES_DEMO, five calls per frame (step 1, three experts, step 3)
provenance.note_en: The model `qwen3.8-27b-fp8`, the weights Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 served by vLLM on the author's A6000 server and reached over Tailscale, was shown each frame with the prompt recorded beside it, and its completion is recorded here verbatim, apart from the `</think>` strip and surrounding whitespace. The calls were made by the application's own provider, `app/vlm/openai_compat.py`, with the frame attached, thinking disabled, temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, presence_penalty 1.5 and max_tokens 2048. Greedy decoding degenerated on the first call (one triplet repeated until 8192 tokens, 287 s), and these are the model family's published non-thinking settings. The seed is derived from each exchange's key (the first 8 hex digits, read as an integer), so a call can be reproduced from this file, and the three experts, whose prompts differ only in the expert index, sample independently instead of sharing one random stream. Each completion is one seeded sample, not the model's only answer. A graph replayed from this file is nevertheless `reconstructed`, because the replay is not the call: the application did not ask a model anything when it read this file.
provenance.note_zh: 本檔各筆 completion 係將各影格連同其旁所錄之提示送入模型 `qwen3.8-27b-fp8`（權重 Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8，由作者之 A6000 伺服器以 vLLM 提供，經 Tailscale 連線）後之輸出，除去 `</think>` 及其前文與首尾空白外，逐字記錄。呼叫由本應用程式自身之 provider（`app/vlm/openai_compat.py`）發出，並附上該影格，關閉 thinking，temperature 為 0.7，top_p 為 0.8，top_k 為 20，presence_penalty 為 1.5，max_tokens 為 2048。貪婪解碼（temperature 0）於首次呼叫即退化（單一三元組重複至 8192 個 token，歷時 287 秒），故改用該模型系列所公布之非思考模式設定。seed 由各筆 exchange 之 key 推得（取前 8 位十六進位數，轉為整數），使任一呼叫可由本檔重現，且三位專家之提示僅專家序號不同，取樣互相獨立，不共用同一隨機序列。各筆 completion 僅為一次以該 seed 取得之取樣，並非該模型之唯一答案。然而由本檔重播所得之圖仍屬 `reconstructed`，因重播並非呼叫：讀取本檔時，應用程式並未向任何模型提問。

prompt_step1:
INFORMATION
You are given one video frame from an industrial workcell.
Extract every relation you can see as <subject, predicate, object> triplets.

TRIPLETS EXTRACTION CRITERIA -- object categories
- left hand
- right hand
- beam
- brace
- block
- wheel
- axle
- pin
- nut
- washer
- assembly
- instruction sheet
- workbench

TRIPLETS EXTRACTION CRITERIA -- predicate dictionary
- holding
- assembling
- attached to
- inserted into
- on
- near
- reaching for

TRIPLETS EXTRACTION CRITERIA -- examples
[positive] <right hand, assembling, assembly> -- The frame is seen through the worker's own eyes, so the worker's right hand is the one on the right of the image unless the arms cross. It is working on the partly built model; `right hand` is in O and `assembling` is in P.
[negative] <left hand, tightening, nut> -- `tightening` is not in P, so this triplet cannot be scored at all.

OUTPUT
One triplet per line, in <subject, predicate, object> form.

experts.analysis_en: The draft triplet `<left hand, holding, block>` was corrected to `<left hand, holding, wheel>` because the object being held is a pink cylindrical piece with a central hole, which corresponds to the `wheel` category in the dictionary rather than a generic `block`. The triplet `<block, attached to, assembly>` was removed as it is not clearly visible or established; the hands are actively manipulating parts, and the specific relationship of a block being 'attached' is ambiguous compared to the direct action of holding. All other triplets accurately describe the static objects (beams, braces, axles, nuts, washers) scattered on the `workbench` and the presence of the `instruction sheet`.
